stack.name: mittwald_stack_deploy
stack.title: Deploy Stack
stack.description: Deploy a docker-compose YAML configuration to a Mittwald stack. Accepts docker-compose format and converts it to Mittwald's native format. IMPORTANT: This is a declarative API - the provided configuration REPLACES the entire stack. Any services or volumes not included will be DELETED. You MUST first read the existing stack configuration (using mittwald_stack_get) before updating, then merge your changes with the existing services/volumes to avoid data loss.

parameters.name: stackId
parameters.description: ID of the stack to deploy to

parameters.name: composeYaml
parameters.description:
Docker-compose YAML content as a string. Supports services with image, ports, environment, volumes, command, and entrypoint. Example: "version: '3'
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports:
      - '80:80'"
